text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is he nervous?
Victoire Pisa barely opened his mouth,
only quietly keeping his eyes closed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Did her last defeat
really hit her that hard...?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's already time.
Time flew by while I was visualizing
today's race.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Still, it all connected—
the path to victory, that is.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'll be able to run a race
that everyone will enjoy today.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall be on my way.
